description: Hands the project's committed record to the session as it opens: the decisions in force and the adopted patterns, by name, and, beside it, the memories and observations recorded for the project, from every tree this machine holds, the ones that share a word with what the session touches first. At each edit, hands over the rules of the record addressed at that path, beside the result of that write (and where a rule of that record asks for it, pauses the write until a person decides, and where a rule refuses it, does not let the write happen, citing the rule either way) in Claude Code through a call into the server, and in VS Code and Cursor, whose hooks are processes, through a command each: VS Code's that Claude Code and Cursor never match, and Cursor's, which runs only where Cursor says it is the host and refuses alone, since its agent does not pause a write for a person. Every one of those is recorded as a fact of the chain. When a subagent starts, hands it the same document the session opened with. At the end of a response that wrote a file, and before a conversation is compacted, says how many files the session's own tool calls wrote and how many decisions were recorded since it opened (a count, which records nothing). And, only where somebody switched it on, at the end of a response records the places where the person corrected the agent, and the answers the person gave to its questions, as proposed decisions in the machine's private tree. And, after a write in Claude Code, unless somebody switched it off, copies a note the host wrote to its own memory into the machine's private tree (never its index, never a note about the person); and beside a write to a file that holds decisions the record cites nowhere, names once per session the command that reads it in (a line, which records nothing). And, where a subagent is about to stop, sends it back once if its final reply does not end in the block of decisions the record asks it to hand over, with the format. And, after a question the agent asked the person was answered, hands the agent one sentence saying that a choice may have been settled there and which tool records it (it records nothing, and reads which tool ran, never the answer). And, after the host's agent tool ran and when a session ends, unless somebody switched it off, records the work the session handed to other agents as one private task for the session with a private handoff for each dispatch (its short description and the path of a brief file, never the prompt), and closes the task at the end. Each can be switched off with `mnema switch`, which records that it was.

hooks.command: IN=$(cat); case "$IN" in *'"create_file"'*|*'"replace_string_in_file"'*|*'"insert_edit_into_file"'*|*'"edit_notebook_file"'*|*'"multi_replace_string_in_file"'*|*'"apply_patch"'*) printf '%s' "$IN" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/edit-asks-a-person.mjs" --host vscode --tools create_file,replace_string_in_file,insert_edit_into_file,edit_notebook_file,multi_replace_string_in_file,apply_patch --agent-key vscode;; esac
IN=$(cat); case "$IN" in *'"AskUserQuestion"'*) printf '%s' "$IN" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/choice-settled.mjs";; esac

[ -n "$CURSOR_VERSION" ] && exit 0; IN=$(cat); P=${IN#*\"file_path\":\"}; P=${P%%\"*}; case "$P" in */memory/*.md|*/adr/*.md|*/decisions/*.md|*/CLAUDE.md|*/AGENTS.md|*/GEMINI.md|*/.claude/rules/*|*/.cursor/rules/*|*/.github/copilot-instructions.md|*[hH][aA][nN][dD][oO][fF][fF]*.md|*[pP][lL][aA][nN]*.md|*[lL][eE][dD][gG][eE][rR]*.md|*[lL][iI][vV][rR][oO]*.md) ;; "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"/*) exit 0;; *.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; printf '%s' "$IN" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/after-a-write.mjs"
IN=$(cat); case "$IN" in *'"Agent"'*|*'"Task"'*) printf '%s' "$IN" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/agent-dispatched.mjs";; esac
